items.message: Second edit is asserted to have replaced the first staging, but the `len == 1` check may pass even if `record` appends rather than replaces.
No test for `_current` returning a read-refusal string when the guard fires on a file that has *no* staged version.

Symlink-outside-repo case asserts 'no file at' but the implementation path for a symlink pointing outside relies on `workspace.inside()` — no test verifies the symlink is refused because it escapes, vs refused because the link target does not exist.
